title: Hope Rising When You Stand on God's Word
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a message of hope and faith, showing us that no matter what challenges we face, we can overcome them when we stand on the promises of God's Word. Through a mix of humor and Scripture, Pastor Zehner reminds us that our faith is rooted in the hope of God's promises, and that when we stand on those promises, we can face anything that comes our way. Don't miss this inspiring message that will encourage you to trust in God's goodness and provision.
